lines.line: Devlog. The cloak that wouldn't sit still.
When the page loaded, her cloak started as a straight sheet, hanging right through her lap and the chair.
For a second it fought its way out, and settled into a drape she never makes.
Now, before the first frame, she quietly stands up and sits down, with the cloth simulated the whole way.
Then there was a fine buzz. Cloth on the seat crept to the edges, and slipped off, a little at a time.
The fix was friction. Cloth resting on the seat stays put, unless it's pulled harder than the seat grips.
No pops, and the cloak moves a third as much while she sits.
